name: airstay
description: AirStay: a home-rental marketplace. Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, SQLite.

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend
scripts.check:backend: node scripts/uv.mjs run ruff check . && node scripts/uv.mjs run ruff format --check . && node scripts/uv.mjs run mypy && node scripts/uv.mjs run pytest
scripts.check:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix frontend run build
